notes.title: New Update for Casey Powell Lacrosse 18
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

A new update has just gone live for Casey Powell Lacrosse 18.

This new update adds in practice mode, this can be selected from the main menu and has two unique practice modes.

3 on G practice features you and 2 teammates against a goalie. This helps you practice your passing and shooting.

4 on 4 practice features you and 3 teammates against 3 opponents and a goalie. This helps you refine your passing and shooting in between defenders as well as helping you work out your formations. You'll also be able to defend against the AI when and if you lose the ball.

This update also corrects a number of stability issues as well as.

Cheers,
HBK619.
